name: Canva
description: Canva lets users create and edit designs in words, search their own design library, upload and organize assets, export in the format a channel needs, and leave comments where the work is. Each user signs in to their own Canva account, and the agent can do what that account can do.

prompts.text: Show me my most recently edited Canva design.
Resize my launch poster for Instagram and export both as PNG.
Turn these release notes into a six-slide Canva presentation.

apps.name: Canva
apps.description: Design creation and editing, library search, asset and brand management, exports, and comments, over one MCP server.
